form.label: EURO PRIOR
form.method: 2025/26 position-relative UWCL fantasy prior using 65% points/90 + 35% total points; shrunk toward neutral for low minutes. Price/value is deliberately excluded.

decision.note: Preseason Decision uses Fixture + EURO PRIOR only. A true event-based Involvement signal is intentionally omitted until underlying chance-creation / near-return data are available.
